metric_scope.regular_innings: innings 1 and 2; these receive pressure labels
metric_scope.additional_innings: retained in a separate unclassified metric group; not mixed into pressure or ordinary baselines
metric_scope.all_competitions: all competition records supplied to the pressure-enriched dataframe

batting_measurement_definitions.balls_faced: striker delivery records excluding extras_type='wide'; Overstep/no-ball records count; the single Penalty-coded record is retained in the primary count and a second balls-faced/strike-rate variant excludes it
batting_measurement_definitions.recorded_runs: sum of the source runs column; labelled recorded_runs because the pack has no complete data dictionary and extras coding contains anomalies
batting_measurement_definitions.fours_and_sixes: count of is_four and is_six flags; not inferred from runs==4/6, because some 4/6 run values have no boundary flag
batting_measurement_definitions.dismissals: is_wicket events attributed using dismissed_player_id; run-outs and non-striker dismissals are attributed to the dismissed batter, not automatically to striker
batting_measurement_definitions.missing_dismissal_id: not assigned to any player; explicitly counted in this audit
